name: nonsense-machine
description: Generate unpredictable nonsense and verify its server receipt.

interface.longDescription: Give the local MCP server any word. It generates a fresh nonsense verdict, random token and receipt, then verifies that receipt. Requires Node.js 20+ and npm/npx in a desktop host with local MCP support.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Nonsense Machine with the word teapot. Generate and verify the result.

publication.release_notes: Move workflow instructions into the MCP instructions tool; skill body only calls instructions.
